primary_metric.name: test_mse
primary_metric.unit: squared response units; absolute MSE difference
primary_metric.aggregation: For each of 12 independent dataset seeds, compute d = OLS test MSE - ridge(lambda=0.1) test MSE. Report mean paired d and a two-sided 95% t interval (df=11).

secondary_metrics.name: coefficient_l2_norm
secondary_metrics.purpose: exploratory mechanism clue, not mechanism proof

data.split_policy: Per seed: independent train n=64 and final test n=4096, d=32. Separate smoke seeds 11,12,13; final seeds 101..112. No tuning.
data.license_review: No external dataset; synthetic generator and new code require review before release.
data.contamination_check: No personal or external data. This is a public synthetic exercise, not a contamination-resistant benchmark.

baselines.description: Unregularized least squares using an SVD-based solver; intercept unpenalized. Same training-only standardization as candidates.

candidate.description: Ridge regression with fixed lambda=0.1; intercept unpenalized. Objective mean squared training residual + lambda * squared L2 coefficient norm.
candidate.change_scope: Only the regularization coefficient differs from OLS.
candidate.search_space: No hyperparameter search. lambda=0.1 fixed before any final result.
candidate.selection_rule: No candidate selection from final results; report fixed primary comparison even if negative.

analysis.independent_unit: One newly sampled training/test dataset pair per seed. Individual test rows are not independent training replicates.
analysis.effect_estimator: Mean of 12 paired differences (OLS MSE minus ridge-0.1 MSE). Positive is improvement.
analysis.interval_method: Two-sided Student t interval for paired dataset-level differences, df=11. Inspect all differences; do not choose a new test after seeing results. Small-n and distributional assumptions disclosed.
analysis.multiple_comparisons: One confirmatory primary contrast. All ablation contrasts descriptive/exploratory; no confirmatory significance claims.
analysis.missing_and_failed_runs: Keep every failure. Retry only deterministic infrastructure interruption, same code/config/data, at most one retry each and six retries globally. If fewer than 12 complete primary pairs, report inconclusive and no confirmatory claim.
analysis.falsification_rule: Support minimum-effect hypothesis only if lower interval bound > 0.05. If upper bound < 0.05, minimum-effect claim not supported; if upper bound < 0, evidence of degradation. If interval includes 0.05, inconclusive. Integrity failure invalidates affected evidence.

budget.accounting_policy: 12 smoke fits + 48 final fits + at most 6 total retries = 66 attempts. Max 30 seconds per fit. Total one hour includes generation, failures, analysis and all subprocesses. Offline CPU only.
budget.confirmation_reserve: Reserve 48 fit attempts for all final methods; do not consume reserve on exploration. No discretionary search.

evaluation.final_test_access_policy: One planned final batch after code, data, evaluator and protocol are frozen; execute all four methods without adaptive changes. Separate custodian account required for actual isolation.
evaluation.baseline_fairness_rule: Same generated train/test pairs, preprocessing, numeric precision, solver tolerance and CPU constraints; no method-specific tuning.

environment.hardware: CPU only; exact hardware and numeric library versions must be recorded before freezing.
environment.model_or_api_version: Not applicable: no language model/API calls.

stopping_rules: Stop at one hour total wall time or 66 total fit attempts, whichever comes first.
Pause on non-finite data/metric, mismatched hashes, unexpected network access or evaluator modification.
If implementation bug is found after final results, preserve original run, mark invalid, and seek a new plan; do not silently repair and reuse final data as unseen.
